home.badge: Short links that actually get tracked
home.title: Short links, measurable clicks.
home.subtitle: Create short, memorable links in seconds. Share them anywhere and watch the clicks roll in from a clean real-time dashboard.
home.featuresTitle: Everything a serious short link needs.
home.featuresSubtitle: Built for makers, marketers, and teams who care about knowing which links actually work.
home.feature1Desc: Paste a long URL, pick a slug or auto-generate one. Done — no configuration hell.
home.feature2Desc: Clicks per day, week, month. Every click is recorded the moment it happens, no batch delays.
home.feature3Desc: Every short link runs through /r/[slug], so even clicks from your own dashboard get tracked.
home.feature4Desc: Local Postgres by default. No third-party trackers, no analytics farms, no surprises.
home.feature5Desc: Built on Next.js 16 with a local-first architecture. Redirects happen in milliseconds.
home.feature6Desc: Purple-tinted dark mode, smooth animations, no clutter. Designed to feel premium, not enterprise.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to see what your links are doing?
home.ctaSubtitle: Set up takes less than a minute. No card, no email confirmation dance — just create an account and start shortening.
